gitGuard.title: Block destructive git
gitGuard.description: Stops Claude from pushing to main, force pushing, reset --hard, clean -f, branch -D, checkout . or restore ., and gh pr merge. Turn it off on a reviewer's own machine. With it off, the pane offers Merge it on a PR that is ready.
